synonyms: Acalypha ostryifolia Riddell ex J.M.Coult. (current Kew heterotypic synonym; nomenclatural proposal may affect preferred usage)
taxonomic_note: Current POWO/WCVP accepts Acalypha persimilis and treats A. ostryifolia as a synonym, but a recent nomenclatural conservation proposal creates ongoing name uncertainty.
look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST — Acalypha persimilis (the concept widely treated as A. ostryifolia): TALL ANNUAL often 35–70 cm with alternate ovate, heart-based, serrate leaves on long stalks. Male STAMINATE flower spikes arise from leaf AXILS; female PISTILLATE flower spikes are TERMINAL (or seem axillary on short branchlets). Each loosely separated female bract has roughly 13–17 long LINEAR finger-like lobes (range 9–17), unlike A. phleoides' 5–7 triangular lobes and bisexual spike or A. radians' crowded spatulate lobes. Do not split A. persimilis from A. ostryifolia into duplicate project cards: the familiar name has an active 2025 formal nomenclatural conservation proposal. Keep the canonical identity/name-status unresolved until authoritative final ruling.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Acalypha persimilis / ostryifolia: Annual, heart-based serrate leaves, male spikes axillary, female spikes terminal, 13–17 long narrow bract lobes | Acalypha phleoides: Perennial, short petioles and a terminal MIXED spike, spaced bracts mostly 5–7 triangular lobes | Acalypha radians: Small round deeply crenate leaves and dioecious habit; female bracts crowded, 8–10 broad spoon lobes | Acalypha virginica / rhomboidea (comparison-only): Often all axillary flower structures and different bract lobing; check local specimens before accepting a species

photo_diagnostic_lesson.title: Hophornbeam copperleaf — terminal female / axillary male spikes

steps.what: Find upright plant and photograph a broad leaf base, long petiole, and serrated margin.
At a leaf/stem angle, look for the staminate axis and capture its insertion into the axil.
Find female spikes at growing tips and compare same individual's male spikes in axils.
One bract with actual fingers in focus, preferably ruler/scale; don't count leaf margin teeth.

steps.look: A. ostryifolia currently synonym in POWO; formal name conservation proposed
steps.what: Keep just one canonical card; old field guides using ostryifolia refer to same working biological concept.
